measurement_scope.process: native ONNX Runtime C API child only; Python excluded
measurement_scope.memory: fresh-process VmRSS/VmHWM plus smaps_rollup; matched-phase same-shape ReduceMean null-model differential
measurement_scope.latency: OrtRun only; run1 first inference, run2/run3 warm

interpretation_contract.inference_resident_delta: CAM++ run-time resident increase minus null-model run-time increase
interpretation_contract.allocator_transient_upper_bound: MaxInUse after run minus InUse before run, only when run raises MaxInUse
interpretation_contract.arena_backing_growth: TotalAllocated counter delta; capacity growth, never activation size
interpretation_contract.serialized_initializer_payload: exact ONNX initializer payload, not necessarily resident weight RSS

model_and_weight_memory.note: The load delta contains weights, prepacked copies, graph/session metadata, and CAM++-specific code pages; RSS cannot split them exactly.

activation_and_transient_memory.note: Resident delta includes activation, scratch, and lazy page faults. Arena backing growth is capacity growth, not activation size. The allocator transient value is an upper bound, not tensor-only memory.

allocator_transient_peak_upper_bound.note: Upper bound includes output and allocator-managed scratch. It is only reported when this run raises the allocator MaxInUse high-water mark.
